errors.name: bad merge + ide + toolbars
errors: data.merge.toolbar must be one of: host, merged, guest
data.merge.ribbon is not a chrome kind (banner, app-menu, nav-menu, context-menu, toolbar, widgets)
data.ide.on must be true or false
data.ide.paneLimit must be a whole number 1..64
data.ide.preset must be a dock-layout asset id
data.ide.presets must be a list of dock-layout asset ids
data.ide.tree must be a preset tree (leaf { pane } or split { vertical, children, weights })
data.toolbars[0].slot must be 1..3
data.toolbars[1].visible must be true or false
data.toolbars[1].location must be one of: top, bottom, left, right
data.toolbars[1].items[0].label is required
data.toolbars[1].items[0].action is required
data.toolbars[1].items[1].open must be one of: main, floating, pane
data.toolbars[1].items[1].app "nope" is not one of data.apps
data.toolbars[2].slot 1 repeats
data.toolbars[3] must be an object
